THE ROLE
At Everpure, we build the high-performance foundation of the Enterprise Data Cloud, delivering six 9s of continuous availability to global organizations. As a Systems Software Engineer on our Core Engineering team, you will design and scale critical distributed infrastructure handling massive data volumes under rigorous latency constraints. Partnering closely with multi-functional engineering teams, you will shepherd complex technical initiatives from design to production rollout, directly expanding the capabilities and resilience of our platform.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Architect Resilient Distributed Systems: Design, implement, and optimize mission-critical platform components—spanning distributed consensus, concurrency control, and fault-tolerant storage—to sustain seamless six 9s availability and ultra-low latency for global enterprise workloads.
Lead High-Impact Technical Initiatives: Drive core platform capabilities from technical design and prototyping through production rollout, partnering with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable software that expands our cloud infrastructure.
Tackle Complex Systems Challenges: Analyze and resolve multi-faceted issues across resource scheduling, data durability, and hardware-software bottlenecks, ensuring robust system predictability and throughput under peak customer demands.
Champion Engineering Quality & Mentorship: Elevate team-wide engineering practices through thoughtful architectural discussions, thorough code reviews, and cross-team collaboration, cultivating an inclusive environment of continuous learning and technical innovation.
WHAT YOU BRING
Core Systems Programming: Proficiency in writing modern, high-performance, and concurrent C++, with a focus on code clarity, maintainability, and testing discipline.
Distributed Systems & OS Fundamentals: Solid foundation in distributed systems concepts (such as consistency models, replication, and fault recovery) and Linux systems internals (including memory management, multi-threading, and I/O performance).
Analytical Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to dissect complex architectural problems, debug distributed anomalies across system layers, and make balanced technical trade-offs between performance, simplicity, and reliability.
Collaborative Technical Execution: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with an eagerness to share knowledge, align across functional engineering teams, and deliver impactful technical solutions together.
